recall.request:
按我们刚才确认的图继续做：还在排队的任务，轮到它开始准备时检查当时的权限；检查时已撤销共享就取消。若开始前已恢复共享，这个尚未取消的任务可以继续。已经开始准备的可以完成、领取；已经取消的不会自动恢复，需重新申请。其他同事的权限、上传者自己的下载和公告板照旧。
Coordination: this change also adopts the already-identified deterministic provider tooling upgrade from source-index-final-skills/vibelens to ordered-evidence-skills/vibelens. Use the retained accepted provider only for this strict begin; all implementation, inspect, generation and verification use the new immutable provider.

concepts.action: Preserve confirmed meaning; bind actual source and evidence. Review only affected semantic changes.

state.scan: state declarations, identities, resources and waits
state.observe: actual transitions, residence and activity evidence

rules.scan: predicate sources, arguments and shared dependencies
rules.observe: evaluated/skipped conditions and actual enclosing invocation

implementation.scan: routes, source hierarchy, declarations, parameters and data-access bindings
implementation.observe: actual calls, responses, selected values and native transaction boundaries; unobserved declarations remain static

unknown.scan: unclassified declarations requiring a mapping review

preserve: native principal/object facts and protected context comparisons

requirements.text: Real username/password sessions and logout; three test accounts, one announcement editor; no registration or account management UI.
Only uploader/current recipients see files; only uploader manages grants; no recipient re-sharing.
Authorize at submission, preserve an admitted task after revocation and allow repeated collection by its original requester; deny new tasks after revocation.
Independent authenticated board; designated editor manages only own announcements; role adds no file rights.

recall.next: Preserve accepted obligations. Update affected layers and source bindings; run scan, inspect, verify, accept and check. Missing boundaries or values are mapping failures, independent of business results.

exclusions: This contract selects state lifecycles. Permission expressions, input facts, task admission commit, HTTP and UI callbacks remain required by the complete concept, implementation, mapping and independent business gates.
No finite analysis, refinement proof, distributed atomicity or exactly-once guarantee is configured.

impact.meaning: Potential impact through declared prerequisites; not observed execution

behavior.next: Rebind source facts automatically; resolve only changed meaning through scoped dialogue; run original verify/accept/check gates.
